baseline: bde2f62c, isolated H200 source snapshot before feature integration
status_note: Implementation status describes the mechanism or observation contract, not whether a measured value is constant.

groups.name: Physical deadline budget and ready lead
groups.merge_rationale: Tempo, lookahead and guard jointly define usable physical time; none independently determines feasibility.

parameters.name: tempo
parameters.source: v3 start.tempo_bpm; all stage measurements at 90 BPM
parameters.definition: Musical beat rate used to map beat positions into physical time.
parameters.type_domain: positive finite number; measured value 90

parameters.name: lead_vector
parameters.source: application/rap/lyric_session.py; v3 start payload
parameters.definition: Separate target horizons for lyric and source readiness, not guaranteed prepared coverage.
parameters.type_domain: object of positive integer bar counts

parameters.name: counterfactual_deadline
parameters.definition: Hypothetical source-ready cutoff at the original bar obligation under a fixed observed cost trace. This shifts deadlines only; changed-lookahead admission and queueing are not resimulated.
parameters.type_domain: finite nonnegative millisecond values derived from BPM, lead and guard

groups.observation_method: Read start payload and source-ready event/receipt timestamps; sweep physical deadlines offline.
groups.clock_and_uncertainty: Client monotonic spans only; counterfactual keeps costs fixed, omits preparation/playback and is not a clock-calibrated acoustic result.

groups.name: Stage service demand and effective resource capacity
groups.merge_rationale: An in-flight request count is not execution capacity; stage demand and the real lock/placement graph jointly determine queueing.

parameters.name: resource_placement
parameters.source: isolated deployment *.pid.json
parameters.definition: Mapping of distinct model services to authorized physical devices and endpoints.
parameters.type_domain: explicit GPU/process/port identities; GPUs 0, 1, 2 in this deployment

parameters.name: request_concurrency
parameters.source: stages --study concurrency
parameters.definition: Number of independent sessions admitted simultaneously by the experiment client.
parameters.type_domain: positive integer; measured levels 1 and 2

parameters.name: source_render_capacity
parameters.source: infrastructure/rap/moss_aligned_phrase.py: render_source lock
parameters.definition: Number of source synthesis/alignment calls that may execute inside the renderer lock at once.
parameters.type_domain: positive integer; inspected implementation fixes this to 1

parameters.name: stage_cost_profile
parameters.source: manifest stage_timings_ms; render_total includes lock wait and overhead
parameters.definition: Observed server stage spans and response totals, retaining their different queue boundaries.
parameters.type_domain: object of finite nonnegative durations and integer observation counts

groups.observation_method: Read isolated process config and source-renderer lock; summarize manifest stage_timings_ms and paired makespans.
groups.clock_and_uncertainty: Server-local stage spans and client-local totals; no cross-host subtraction. Residual mixes lock wait and overhead; only three paired groups. Twelve bars per condition are clustered within sessions; there are three paired groups.

groups.name: Useful candidate budget and acceptance
groups.merge_rationale: Candidate count, rescue waves and minimum acceptable yield form one bounded search policy; yield is an outcome, not an independent knob.

parameters.name: candidate_policy
parameters.source: application/rap/lyric_writer.py: LyricWriterPolicy
parameters.definition: Initial and rescue search budget, desired valid stopping count, and selectable-score threshold.
parameters.type_domain: integer counts/waves; minimum_valid is a rescue stopping criterion, not mandatory success count

parameters.name: usable_yield
parameters.source: raw candidate ledgers under fixed syllable and scoring gates
parameters.definition: Structurally valid candidates and attempts with at least one selectable result after budget exhaustion.
parameters.type_domain: nonnegative integer counts; empirical means may be real

parameters.name: writer_latency
parameters.source: client perf_counter spans; first cold CMU initialization retained
parameters.definition: Elapsed client-host time around the complete writer attempt including generation and evaluation.
parameters.type_domain: finite nonnegative milliseconds

groups.observation_method: Execute real writer, preserve every prompt/raw wave/ledger and selected record; compare matched workloads.
groups.clock_and_uncertainty: Requesting host perf_counter; cold first evaluation retained; 12 matched workloads, seed not bitwise guarantee, no CI or significance. Budget 32 is always middle in order; routes ran separately, so median differences do not isolate network latency.

groups.name: Revision pressure and invalidation
groups.merge_rationale: Edit arrival pressure matters through the dependent work it invalidates and whether that work can actually stop; numeric content revision is not edit sequence.

parameters.name: edit_trace
parameters.source: research_update_sent and superseded events; actual send times preserved
parameters.definition: Observed or configured sequence of input edits and their effective suffix scope.
parameters.type_domain: ordered event offsets in milliseconds; actual sends and acknowledgments recorded separately

parameters.name: latest_source_delay
parameters.source: latest lyric ID and final topic verified after final edit acknowledgement
parameters.definition: Time from initial request until the final-topic, latest-identity source package arrives.
parameters.type_domain: finite nonnegative milliseconds; outcomes grouped by scenario, not isolated edit-count effect

parameters.name: cancellation_and_reuse_policy
parameters.current_value: Observed obsolete source can finish; newer content replaces only eligible uncommitted work
parameters.source: baseline lyric_session and source renderer; no cancellation latency trace
parameters.definition: Stage-specific behavior for stopping obsolete work and deciding whether completed artifacts remain eligible.
parameters.type_domain: categorical policy; cancellation latency and executed waste unknown

groups.observation_method: Collect scheduled and actual edit sends, accepted sequence, lyric identity/topic, and eligible source receipt.
groups.clock_and_uncertainty: Session client monotonic clock; edits polled at 50 ms. Final topics differ; no exact cancellation or audible-effect timing.

groups.name: Transport and local preparation reserve
groups.merge_rationale: Remote source completion is not local playback readiness; transfer, warp/mix and enqueue reserve must stay on the critical path.

parameters.name: transport_profile

current_value.topology: Mac SSH forward to H200; separate H200 loopback control

parameters.source: run manifests, response headers, byte counts
parameters.definition: Configured client/server route and source-package representation.
parameters.type_domain: categorical topology/codec plus nonnegative payload sizes

parameters.name: mac_source_ready
parameters.source: Mac-observed request-to-source receipt; not isolated network latency
parameters.definition: Client-observed complete source-package receipt time including upstream work and transport.
parameters.type_domain: finite nonnegative milliseconds from session request

parameters.name: mac_warp_mix_cost
parameters.source: real Rubber Band 4.0.0 and product BarAudioPreparer; finite non-silent output checked
parameters.definition: Elapsed local production preparation call and validation of its destination audio shape.
parameters.type_domain: finite nonnegative milliseconds; integer frame/rate/channel counts

groups.observation_method: Measure Mac source-package receipt and real local BarAudioPreparer calls; validate WAV/PCM and output frames.
groups.clock_and_uncertainty: Mac perf_counter spans; source receipt includes upstream work. One network session, 12 preparations, device timing absent.

groups.name: Granularity and causal dependency contract
groups.merge_rationale: The granularity vector constrains which schedules are legal; sample placement does not imply partial semantic output.

parameters.name: measured_output_units
parameters.source: v3 baseline contracts; no device playback measured here
parameters.definition: Existing stage-level semantic units and placement resolutions, with measurement versus contract distinguished.
parameters.type_domain: categorical bar/phrase/tick/sample units; no conversion assumed without explicit mapping

parameters.name: finer_output_granularity
parameters.source: research design granularity vector; NOT implemented or benchmarked as output units
parameters.definition: Hypothetical partial semantic generation, synthesis or commitment below one bar.
parameters.type_domain: unknown; not implemented or measured as an output schedule

groups.observation_method: Inspect baseline stage contracts and validate deterministic dependency/release invariants.
groups.clock_and_uncertainty: Structural units, not timing measurements; no beat/tick semantic output benchmark. Sample placement is an inspected contract.

groups.name: Eligible coverage, cache identity and fallback obligation
groups.merge_rationale: A completed but stale artifact can preserve continuity without satisfying a fresh-input obligation; caches and fallback must use the same eligibility relation.

parameters.name: eligible_ready_coverage
parameters.source: model quantity; no continuous buffer occupancy trace in this study
parameters.definition: Union of ready, integrity-valid, dependency-compatible and epoch/policy-eligible output intervals, preserving holes before the playback frontier.
parameters.type_domain: set of musical intervals; unmeasured continuous state

parameters.name: cache_dependency_key
parameters.source: conservative dependency model; source tempo independence is not assumed
parameters.definition: Declared complete producer-input identity required for dependency compatibility; reuse additionally requires readiness, integrity and session/epoch/fidelity/expiry eligibility.
parameters.type_domain: tuple of version/hash/value identities; missing key forbids reuse

parameters.name: fresh_vs_continuous_output
parameters.source: device playback, fallback, echo duration and acoustic verification belong to feature acceptance, not these source-stage tests
parameters.definition: Separate indicators for meeting the declared input/revision obligation and maintaining playback without unintended gaps; intended silence is not a continuity failure.
parameters.type_domain: boolean outcome pair per obligation; not measured by source-stage tests

groups.observation_method: Check declared cache dependencies and stale/fresh boundary invariants; retain missing coverage telemetry explicitly.
groups.clock_and_uncertainty: Model quantities only; no continuous cache/coverage/device timeline or fresh-vs-continuous performance estimate.

output_metrics.role: Descriptive outcomes, separate from controls and the seven parameter groups; no expected-value model, prediction, fitted map or weighted objective is asserted.
output_metrics.missingness: Null means unmeasured, not zero or failure. Any future response-gap study must retain timeout/nonresponse cases and observation-window bounds separately from observed successful response times.

components.name: continuity
components.definition: Intended interval played without an unintended gap; permitted fallback can maintain continuity without freshness.
components.source: No device-playback observation in this worker's study; non-silent source WAVs do not establish playback continuity.

components.name: freshness
components.scope: output obligation with declared input/revision cutoff
components.definition: On-time output satisfies the obligation's input/revision cutoff and eligibility, assessed at the explicitly named output stage.
components.source: Latest-source identity/topic/acknowledgment checks and fixed-source-trace deadline sensitivity are available; they do not measure audible freshness.

components.name: content_validity
components.scope: writer output under declared flow and selection gates
components.unit: boolean per candidate or selected output; counts retain denominator
components.definition: Writer output passes the declared structural/selectability gates; distinct from perceptual musical or linguistic quality.
components.current_value: Per-candidate ledgers and paired attempt counts in referenced raw data; no cross-condition pooled score.
components.source: Actual candidate evaluation and selection records.

components.name: quality
components.scope: listener-rated output under a declared rubric
components.definition: Listener-assessed musical/linguistic merit; structural validity and internal candidate ranking are not substituted for this outcome.

components.name: response_gap
components.scope: accepted affected input/edit to first audible eligible response reflecting it
components.unit: ms, with both boundaries measured on a common or calibrated clock
components.definition: Elapsed time from accepted affected input/edit to the first audible response satisfying that input/revision obligation; retain superseded, timeout and nonresponse cases separately.
components.source: Observed request-to-source receipt spans are different boundaries and must not be relabeled as audible response gap.

relationships.release: R_jv=max(policy_release_jv,A_jv,max over (i,u) in pred(j,v) F_iu), including selected-text(j-1) -> writer(j)
relationships.finish: S_jv>=R_jv subject to resource capacity; F_jv=S_jv+C_jv
relationships.deadline: D_j=P_j_ms-M_j; L_j=F_j-D_j; success requires L_j<=0 and current eligibility; F_j is completion at the stage named by the obligation, not necessarily acoustic completion
relationships.causality: every artifact depends only on inputs available at its recorded release watermark
relationships.cache: dependency_compatible iff every actual producer dependency is present and equal; reuse additionally requires ready, integrity_valid and epoch/policy eligibility
relationships.revision: plan edit sequence, per-bar content revision and timeline revision are distinct identifiers
relationships.coverage: eligible coverage is the union of intervals of reuse-eligible artifacts, including readiness, integrity, dependency and epoch/policy eligibility, not furthest ready position
relationships.yield: usable candidates=sum(structurally_valid and selectable); no candidate-independence formula assumed
relationships.critical_path: max dependent-path sum of stage service costs, including transfer if modeled; lower bound without queueing and omitted stages, not an end-to-end percentile estimator
relationships.units: R,S,F,A,Q,D,P,M,C are common-clock request-relative milliseconds; timeline T is seconds, B is beats/min, fs is samples/s; P_ms=1000*(T(beta)-request_time_seconds)

evidence_scope_note: Feature four-slot diagnostics and later live integration outcomes are explicitly excluded from every measurement here.
reduction_note: Exploratory grouping, not a measured causal importance ranking, validated minimal model, or schedulability guarantee.

prior_paper.relationship: Retain physical/musical-time and freshness/continuity distinctions; do not import fitted latency laws or interval/generation-length feasibility bounds into the uncalibrated bar-level stage graph.
